US also includes Cephapirin Benzathine for veterinary use. Ph. Eur. 6.2 (Cefapirin Sodium). A white or pale yellow powder. Soluble in water; practically insoluble in dichloromethane. A 1% solution in water has a pH of 6.5 to 8.5. Protect from light. USP 31 (Cephapirin Sodium). A white to off-white crystalline powder, odourless or having a slight odour. Very soluble in wa- ter; insoluble in most organic solvents. pH of a solution in water containing the equivalent of cefapirin 1% is between 6.5 and 8.5. Store in airtight containers.
